name: Square-1 & Sides in Surrey 2026
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e6240fd13450938c58ea02a2948e07de0e818fb2/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) ### *IMPORTANT: Please note that this is a side events competition, meaning that 3x3x3 speedsolving will not be held at this competition. First-time competitors are still very welcome to participate! However, please check the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Square1SidesinSurrey2026#competition-events) to see which events will be offered at this competition before registering.* If you are looking to compete in events that are not being held at this one, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=CA). To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). You are also welcome to join the Facebook group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). Please **review all of the tabs on this website**. You **only need to show up for events that you're competing in**, but we encourage you to stay longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly in the afternoon — **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. An email with information and reminders will be sent a few days before the competition. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media, and other digital platforms.
